body.name: EMI collections
body.description: Outbound calls to remind customers about EMIs and agree a payment date.

parameters.description: Uses the customer's name in the first 15 seconds.
Says their own name and Acme Lending before the reason for the call.
Confirms date of birth or the last four digits of the loan account before discussing it.
Tells the customer the call is recorded.
No threats, shaming or pressure tactics at any point.

parameters.parameter: Stated the EMI amount and due date
parameters.description: States the exact amount and the due date.
Offers UPI link, auto-debit or a branch visit as fits the customer.
Gets a date the customer commits to pay by. N/A when the EMI is already paid.
Acknowledges the customer's situation before moving on.
Recaps amount, date and next step before ending.
